harmful.name: Aspartame
harmful.reason: IARC classified aspartame as possibly carcinogenic to humans (Group 2B) on limited evidence; JECFA retained an ADI of 40 mg/kg body weight.

harmful.name: Sodium Nitrite
harmful.reason: Can contribute to formation of N-nitroso compounds/nitrosamines; food use is therefore tightly regulated.

harmful.name: Sodium Nitrate
harmful.reason: Can contribute to endogenous nitrosation; use is regulated in foods such as cured meats.

harmful.name: Potassium Nitrite
harmful.reason: Nitrite can contribute to formation of potentially carcinogenic N-nitroso compounds; use is controlled.

harmful.name: Potassium Nitrate
harmful.reason: Nitrate can contribute to endogenous nitrosation; use is controlled in regulated food categories.

harmful.name: BHA
harmful.reason: IARC classifies BHA as possibly carcinogenic to humans; permitted uses remain subject to regulatory limits.

harmful.name: Sulfur Dioxide
harmful.reason: Sulfites can trigger adverse reactions, including asthma symptoms, in susceptible individuals; use and declaration are regulated.

harmful.name: Sodium Metabisulfite
harmful.reason: Sulfite exposure can cause adverse reactions in susceptible individuals; regulated levels and labeling apply.

harmful.name: Potassium Metabisulfite
harmful.reason: Sulfite exposure can cause adverse reactions in susceptible individuals; regulated levels apply.

harmful.name: Sodium Bisulfite
harmful.reason: Sulfite exposure can cause adverse reactions in susceptible individuals; regulated levels apply.

harmful.name: Acrylamide
harmful.reason: A processing contaminant formed in some foods at high temperatures; IARC classifies acrylamide as probably carcinogenic to humans (Group 2A).

harmful.name: Industrial Trans Fat
harmful.reason: WHO recommends eliminating industrially produced trans fat because it increases cardiovascular risk.

harmful.name: Sodium Chloride
harmful.reason: Excess dietary sodium raises blood pressure and cardiovascular risk; the concern is high intake, not normal culinary use.

harmful.name: High-Fructose Corn Syrup
harmful.reason: A source of free sugars; high consumption contributes to excess energy intake and dental/metabolic health risk.

harmful.name: Added Sugar
harmful.reason: High intake of free/added sugars increases dental caries risk and contributes to excess energy intake.

harmful.name: Caffeine
harmful.reason: Excessive intake can cause insomnia, anxiety, palpitations and other adverse effects; risk varies by age and pregnancy status.

harmful.name: Sorbitol
harmful.reason: Large amounts can cause gastrointestinal discomfort and laxative effects.

harmful.name: Mannitol
harmful.reason: Large amounts can cause gastrointestinal discomfort and laxative effects.

harmful.name: Xylitol
harmful.reason: High intake can cause gastrointestinal discomfort and laxative effects.

harmful.name: Erythritol
harmful.reason: Large amounts may cause gastrointestinal symptoms; emerging observational findings have not established causation.

harmful.name: 4-Methylimidazole
harmful.reason: A processing by-product associated with some caramel-coloured foods; regulatory limits and exposure assessments vary by jurisdiction.

harmful.name: Phosphate Additives
harmful.reason: Permitted within limits, but high total phosphorus intake can be a concern for people with kidney disease.
